text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Iraqi military spokesman ridicules Kuwait's allegations that Iraq is building up troops near the Kuwaiti borders.
- Iraqi culture and information minister rejects allegations of Kuwaiti information minister on troop build-up.
- Speaker of the National Assembley discusses with Turkish charge d'affaires in Baghdad parliamentary ties between Iraq and Turkey and ways to enhance them.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
- Washington is biased to Ankara in the Cypriot missile crisis.
- Temperature in Baghdad went down to minus 4C over the last two days.
- An ancient village is discovered in Iraq.
